source: APPP / MAFF-JICA — Rice Seed Production Manual (សៀវភៅមគ្គទេសក៍ផលិតកម្មពូជស្រូវ), 2014, Agricultural Productivity Promotion Project in West Tonle Sap, p.25
text: The first top-dress fertilizer application after transplanting uses urea (46-0-0) at a rate of one 50 kg sack per hectare, but its timing depends on the variety's duration class: for early/short-duration varieties (ស្រូវស្រាល), apply 15–20 days after transplanting; for medium-duration varieties (ស្រូវកណ្តាល), apply around 30 days after transplanting; for long-duration/photoperiod-sensitive varieties (ស្រូវធន់), apply 30–40 days after transplanting. Urea's declared nutrient content is N 46%, P 0%, K 0%.
